name: Album of Daoist and Buddhist Themes: Kings of Hells: Leaf 35
summary: This ink line drawing belongs to a set of leafs illustrating the Ten Kings of Hell. The king here seems to render a verdict on four deceased souls: the plaintiffs are an old couple kneeling in the middle and facing the king, the accused are the younger couple to their left.
